data.text:
SUNOG SA CAMP CRAME

Naapula na ang sunog na sumiklab sa isang bahagi ng PNP General Hospital sa loob ng Camp Crame sa Quezon City nitong Linggo ng gabi, August 24.

Pasado alas-10 ng gabi nang sumiklab ang sunog at umakyat pa sa unang alarma bago naapula bandang 11:21 ng gabi.

📸: Baseco Fire & Rescue Volunteer Assoc.

[5:40PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic descending the CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal Market stretch through Ijora Olopa by NEPA intersection is flowing well.

The Broad Street stretch towards Apongbon, including the section underneath the bridge connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, maintains good movement.

Traffic on Eko Bridge inward Apongbon, linking CMS proper, Elegbata, Leventis, and the UBA Roundabout through to both inner and outer Marina, is moving smoothly.

At present, no impediments are observed, and traffic personnel are  present at key locations ensuring ease of traffic movement.

[6:30PM] #MushinOshodi #TrafficUpdate 

Movement around Mushin is mostly smooth.
Traffic along Moshalasi to Ojuwoye, Oshodi Underbridge to Brown Junction, and return journey from Bolade to Ojuwoye are all moving well. 
Some slight congestion is reported near the Oshodi Train Station due to commercial activities, but officers are managing the situation. 
Other stretches like Ojuwoye to Lasutech and Ile Epo to LUTH Junction are moving as expected. 
No major impediments are reported, and officers are on ground ensuring smooth traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA
